page.overview:
Who is Kevin Shiftright?

Kevin Shiftright races for the team "Clutch Aid" in the movie Cars.

"Kevin is the fourth in a long line of racers in the Shiftright family. His great grandfather Kurt raced on the old dirt tracks of the fifties, followed by his grandpa Kraig, who won 2 Piston Cups in the late seventies, and his dad Klint, who won 3 in the early nineties. Kevin tries not to let the pressure of his family history get to him when he's on the track or at the dinner table."

Kevin is one of the thirty-six race cars who compete in the Dinoco 400 at the Motor Speedway of the South. He was one of the many involved in a huge wreck caused by Chick Hicks in the early laps of the race, driving straight into the speedway's wall and later spinning out of control. He received some minor damage and was able to finish the race in 4th place.

Kevin Shiftright appears in Cars: The Video Game, with the name Suregrip. In Palm Mile Speedway, he finished in 4th place; in Motor Speedway of the South, he finished in 4th place; in Sun Valley International Speedway, he finished in 11th place; in Smasherville International Speedway, he finished in 11th place and in Los Angeles International Speedway, he finished in 4th place.
